lines: —So you're telling us that you believe Nobility is actually tied to Spoilage?
We knew they were despicable, but not to this extent.
I have worked as a guard under Lady Svetka ever since she took charge, and I have come across all kinds of nobles.
Consumed with gluttony, they are all happy to stuff their faces with food until they rot in bed.
Spoilage must have originated from those pigs.
I say that we do not stop with our purge of the past, and eradicate anyone who could have ties with nobility.
Men, women, and children all end up the same! We must—
